name: Radiant Devcontainer
postCreateCommand: set -e; PY312=$(command -v python3.12 || echo /usr/local/python/3.12.12/bin/python3); $PY312 -m pip install --upgrade pip poetry; cd /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/cli && poetry env use $PY312 && poetry install; cd /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/server && poetry env use $PY312 && poetry install; cd /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/frontend && npm install
